title: Exploring the effects of naringin on oxidative stress-impaired osteogenic differentiation via the Wnt/beta-catenin and PI3K/Akt pathways.
authors: Wang, Hui; Liang, Jun; Wang, Yiran; Zheng, Junyuan; Liu, Ying; Zhao, Yiyang; Ma, Yixuan; Chen, Pei; Yang, Xufang
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨柚皮苷通过Wnt/β-catenin和PI3K/Akt通路促进氧化应激下成骨分化，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to explore naringin's potential to promote the osteogenic differentiation of MC3T3-E1 under oxidative stress. It delved into Nar's connection with the Wnt/beta-catenin and PI3K/Akt signaling pathways. Initially, 2911 OP-related genes were analyzed, revealing close ties with the PI3K/Akt and Wnt pathways alongside oxidative stress. Nar's potential targets-ESR1, HSP90AA1, and ESR2-were identified through various databases and molecular docking studies confirmed Nar's affinity with ESR1 and HSP90AA1. Experiments established optimal concentrations for Nar and H(2)O(2). H(2)O(2) at 0.3 mmol/L damaged MC3T3-E1 cells, alleviated by 0.1 micromol/L Nar. Successful establishment of oxidative stress models was confirmed by DCFH-DA probe and NO detection. Nar exhibited the ability to enhance osteogenic differentiation, counteracting oxidative damage. It notably increased osteoblast-related protein expression in MC3T3-E1 cells under oxidative stress. The study found Nar's positive influence on GSK-3beta phosphorylation, beta-catenin accumulation, and pathway-related protein expression, all critical in promoting osteogenic differentiation. The research concluded that Nar effectively promotes osteogenic differentiation in MC3T3-E1 cells under oxidative stress. It achieved this by activating the Wnt/beta-catenin and PI3K/Akt pathways, facilitating GSK-3beta phosphorylation, and enhancing beta-catenin accumulation, pivotal in osteogenesis.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨柚皮苷在氧化应激条件下促进MC3T3-E1成骨分化的潜力，并深入研究了柚皮苷与Wnt/β-catenin及PI3K/Akt信号通路的关系。首先，分析了2911个与OP相关的基因，揭示了其与PI3K/Akt和Wnt通路及氧化应激的紧密联系。通过多个数据库鉴定了柚皮苷的潜在靶点——ESR1、HSP90AA1和ESR2，分子对接研究证实了柚皮苷与ESR1和HSP90AA1的亲和力。实验确定了柚皮苷和H(2)O(2)的最佳浓度。0.3 mmol/L的H(2)O(2)对MC3T3-E1细胞造成损伤，而0.1微摩尔/升的柚皮苷可缓解此损伤。通过DCFH-DA探针和NO检测确认了氧化应激模型的成功建立。柚皮苷表现出增强成骨分化、对抗氧化损伤的能力，显著提高了氧化应激条件下MC3T3-E1细胞中成骨相关蛋白的表达。研究发现，柚皮苷对GSK-3β磷酸化、β-catenin积累及通路相关蛋白表达有积极影响，这些在促进成骨分化中均至关重要。研究结论认为，柚皮苷通过激活Wnt/β-catenin和PI3K/Akt通路，促进GSK-3β磷酸化，增强β-catenin积累，有效促进氧化应激条件下MC3T3-E1细胞的成骨分化，这些机制在骨生成中起关键作用。
